exposure: birth year (relative to national vaccination program implementation)
cohort: The study included 162,662 pregnant women with hospital-based prenatal HBV screening data for HBsAg and 161,729 for HBeAg in Taiwan between 2016 and 2021.
finding: The national vaccination program significantly reduced HBV seroprevalence, particularly HBsAg, among pregnant women in Taiwan, with positivity rates decreasing substantially in those born after July 1986.
